review.item_premise: The public encoding boundary observes the public input, ceiling, result and exact reservation usage outside the encoding budget. Its shared counting/writing kernel borrows values. The ceiling and fallible caller meter admit workspace and output requests before site execution. Reservation-site controls do not observe bypass allocations; absence of owned payload copies is a reviewed source property. Existing protected encoding retains legacy allocation sites and every secret loan. The callback is an executable capability, not serializable input.
